problems.title: Two Sum
problems.statement: Given a list of integers and a target, return the indices of the two numbers that add up to the target. Exactly one solution exists. Aim for O(n).

problems.title: Valid Parentheses
problems.statement: Given a string containing only ()[]{} characters, return true if the brackets are balanced and correctly nested.

problems.title: Reverse Words in a String
problems.statement: Reverse the order of words in a sentence. Collapse repeated spaces and trim the ends. Do not use a built-in that does the whole job.

problems.title: Group Anagrams
problems.statement: Given a list of words, group the words that are anagrams of each other. Return a list of groups.

problems.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
problems.statement: Return the length of the longest substring of a string that has no repeating characters. Aim for O(n).

problems.title: Merge Intervals
problems.statement: Given a list of [start, end] intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the result sorted by start.

problems.title: LRU Cache
problems.statement: Design a cache with a fixed capacity supporting get(key) and put(key, value) in O(1). When full, evict the least recently used key.

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.statement: Given a list of integers and k, return the k most frequent elements. Better than O(n log n) is a plus.

problems.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
problems.statement: A sorted array of distinct integers was rotated at an unknown pivot. Find the index of a target in O(log n), or -1.

problems.title: SQL: Second Highest Salary
problems.statement: Table Employee(id, name, salary, department_id). Write a query that returns the second highest distinct salary, or NULL if it does not exist.

problems.title: SQL: Top 3 Earners per Department
problems.statement: Tables Employee(id, name, salary, department_id) and Department(id, name). Return department name, employee name and salary for the top 3 distinct salaries in each department.

problems.title: SQL: Duplicate Emails
problems.statement: Table Person(id, email). Return every email that appears more than once.

problems.title: Design: Rate Limiter
problems.statement: Implement a rate limiter that allows at most N requests per user in any rolling 60 second window. Explain how it behaves under concurrent calls.

problems.title: Flatten Nested JSON
problems.statement: Flatten a nested dict/object into one level with dot-separated keys, e.g. {a:{b:1}} becomes {'a.b':1}. Handle arrays by index.
